messages:
jen_marketing: Quick sync re: launch comms for APAC rollout — we need localized headlines, embargo schedule by region, and legal sign-off for translated quotes. @rishi_apac @claire_localization @legal_kate

rishi_apac: Good catch. APAC markets have varied prime news windows. For SEA/Japan/AU we should stagger: JP 10:00 JST, AU 10:00 AEST, SEA 09:00 SGT. That means one global publish isn't ideal.

claire_localization: We can provide translated headlines + short variants (X/LinkedIn captions) in EN/JP/KO/ZH-SG within 48h. Need final English master copy and the approved CEO quote to localize tone.

legal_kate: Note: translated quotes must match the legal-approved meaning. If any nuance implies product promises (e.g., "guarantees latency"), translations must be reviewed by legal. Recommend we lock the English quote first, then localize.

jen_marketing: Proposal: publish staged posts per region aligned to their morning news cycle and have social pushes 5 minutes after each publish. That reduces global scrape confusion. Thoughts?

press_ops: Works for us. We'll hold the press list per region and release to local media at each regional publish. Also prepare a single global press pack that we attach per-region with localized headline and contact.

oliver_social: For socials, we'll need platform-specific captions and image overlays localized. Claire — can you include 2 image text variants (short + long) so we can A/B?

claire_localization: Yep. Will include image overlay text for hero image and a short caption variant. Also can adapt the CEO quote to a slightly more formal tone for Japan and more conversational for SEA.

ceo_anna: Happy to provide a region-specific variant if that helps (e.g., shorter line for JP). Send me the localized draft and I'll sign off.

rishi_apac: One more: timezone embargo confusion risk. Request: require partners/local PR to confirm their publish window 72h prior. Also add a CMS flag for "regional embargo locked" so no accidental publishes.

legal_kate: Agreed on the CMS flag. I'll add a short localization checklist: (1) English master quote locked, (2) translations reviewed by legal, (3) partner consent for local mentions, (4) no new numeric claims in translations unless validated.

jen_marketing: Timeline: final English master by EOD tomorrow, Claire delivers localized assets in 48h, legal reviews 24h after that, staging links for each region 24h before publish. I'll coordinate the CMS flags.

press_ops: Preparing regional press lists and local spokespeople contacts. Also recommending we time JP to avoid golden week holidays — checking calendar.

oliver_social: For scheduling, please provide the exact local publish minutes. I can queue posts once assets are in. Also ask influencers/local partners to pin their posts to coincide with local publish.

claire_localization: Small localization note: the CEO phrase "shipping fast" reads differently in JP; I'll propose "accelerate time-to-value" variant there.

ceo_anna: I like that wording. Go ahead and draft both; I'll pick the JP-friendly one when you post.

jen_marketing: Action list: Jen finalize English quote (EOD), Claire produce localized headlines + two caption variants (48h), Legal Kate review translations (24h), Rishi confirm region windows and partner signoffs (72h), Press_ops prep regional lists, Oliver queue socials.

rishi_apac: Confirming: JP publish target 2026-05-10 10:00 JST, AU 2026-05-10 10:00 AEST, SEA 2026-05-10 09:00 SGT. Will confirm firm times and partner readiness by Tue.

jen_marketing: Thanks all — I'll drop the English master here shortly. Please flag blockers asap. :rocket:
